title: Locko's Shorts Pack
body:
# Locko's Shorts Pack


![Three images are side by side showing the same minecraft fox character wearing three different types of shorts. On the left, netherite shorts have a white border trin, in the middle, iron shorts with no trim, and the left is diamond shorts with a copper colored drawstring trim.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bb49c325ec78484113c438ea1bc4824c1a72d73.jpeg)

Replaces leggings & pants with shorts. It also lowers the height of all boots by 1 pixel.

All trims have been modified to fit, and some have entirely new designs.

# All Trims
![A grid of armor stands displays each trim on diamond shorts/leggings.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc1e86c684f3564bf77edc2452de1b50ddc7b749.jpeg)
